entry.name: pollInterval
entry.label: How often to re-read microphone state, in milliseconds.

entry.name: backend
entry.label: Which mechanism performs the mute: plasma (plasma-pa over D-Bus) or pactl.

entry.name: muteScope
entry.label: Which sources to mute: all, or default.

entry.name: iconSizeMode
entry.label: auto: track the panel thickness. fixed: use iconSizePx.

entry.name: iconSizePx
entry.label: Icon size in pixels when iconSizeMode is fixed.

entry.name: idleOpacityPercent
entry.label: Icon opacity when live but nothing is recording.

entry.name: showInUseDot
entry.label: Overlay a dot while an application is capturing.

entry.name: pulseInUseDot
entry.label: Pulse the in-use dot instead of showing it steady.

entry.name: showOsd
entry.label: Show a Plasma on-screen message when mute changes.

entry.name: hideWhenIdle
entry.label: Report passive status when live and idle, so the System Tray can hide it.
